notes.title: v1.6 - Improvements and corrections
notes.notes:
After viewing some live streams we've identified some areas of improvement. Thanks to everyone who has been playing! We've been enjoying your content.

Corrections have been added to:
-NPC Names
-Hover over descriptions
-Objects
-Dialogue
-Quest log

The default audio output has now also been switched to DirectSound (was previously using  WaveOut).

If anyone has any issues with these updates please let us know. Bonne chance !

Chaz - Lead Designer

notes.title: v1.4 - corrected: minor typos, quests, achievements, hintbook DLC
notes.notes:
v1.4 contains the following improvements:

-Some minor typos in the dialogue have been corrected
-The achievement for training the sword was not being activated
-One of the quests could sometimes be incorrectly changed to the 'completed' state
-A few minor errors have been corrected in the Hint Book DLC

Thanks to everyone who pointed out these errors. If you experience any issues with this latest update please let us know!

notes.title: Pierre's Adventures in French is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
We are very proud to announce that Pierre's Adventures in French is now available for you all to play!

We really hope you enjoy the experience as a fun way to practice and expand your French vocabulary. Please feel welcome to leave us any feedback on your experience. If you're having any technical issues please let us know so we can address them as quickly as possible.

We wish you the best of luck on your journey to learn French. It will be a long path but we hope we can help make the journey as enjoyable as possible. Supporting this game is not only a fun new way to learn but also an investment in a future with many different types of French learning games (along with other languages!)

Merci beaucoup et bonne chance,

Chaz and Andrea
Rocket Boy Games
